strings.farm_off: Wildroot Farming is off on this server.
strings.farm_about: Grow more crops, faster. Trained by planting and picking them.
strings.farm_stamina_tip: The game's own: each use of the cultivator costs less stamina, down to half at level 100.
strings.farm_scythe_any_tip: The game's own: one swing of a scythe picks every ripe crop in a radius that grows with your level.
strings.farm_reach_tip: The game's own: one swing picks every ripe crop within this radius.
strings.farm_bonus_any: Bonus crop chance grows with level
strings.farm_bonus_any_tip: The game's own: a crop you pick sometimes gives a bonus.
strings.farm_bonus_tip: Chance each crop you pick gives its bonus yield on top.
strings.farm_seed_tip: Chance a pick also gives back the seed the plant grew from.
strings.farm_growth_tip: Everything you plant grows this much faster, saplings too.
strings.farm_growth_tip_rain: Everything you plant grows this much faster, saplings too; rain adds {0}% while it falls.
strings.farm_spacing_tip: Crops you plant need that much less room around them, so they can stand closer.
strings.farm_row_tip: With a 1 × 1 grid, placing a seed plants a row of {0}, each paying its own seed. Hold {1} to plant one.
strings.farm_replant_tip: Picking a crop puts its plant back in the same spot, paid with a seed from your inventory.
strings.farm_heat_tip: Crops you plant grow in the Ashlands without a shield.
strings.farm_cold_tip: Crops you plant that grow in the Meadows also grow in the Mountain and Deep North.
strings.cfg_general__togglekey_help: Shortcut to turn Wildroot on or off while gameplay input is available. It is unbound by default because F8 opens the shared MeadWorks menu. The server controls the master setting in multiplayer.
strings.cfg_grid__snapkey_help: Shortcut to turn snapping to nearby plants on or off. Grid size is unchanged. Unbound by default: use the Grid: SnappingEnabled setting, or hold the controller modifier and click the right stick.
strings.cfg_harvest__replanttogglekey_help: Shortcut to turn replanting after bulk harvest on or off. Replanting still requires the replacement materials and placement permission. Unbound by default: use the Harvest: Replant setting.
strings.cfg_input__increasexkey_help: While holding the grid modifier, add one column to the planting grid, up to 10.
strings.cfg_input__increaseykey_help: While holding the grid modifier, add one row to the planting grid, up to 10.
strings.cfg_input__decreasexkey_help: While holding the grid modifier, remove one column from the planting grid, down to 1.
strings.cfg_input__decreaseykey_help: While holding the grid modifier, remove one row from the planting grid, down to 1.
strings.cfg_input__keyboardmodifierkey_help: Hold this keyboard shortcut to use the grid resize controls while planting.
strings.cfg_input__gamepadmodifierkey_help: Hold this controller button for gardening controls: resize with the directional pad, toggle snapping with the right stick, or bulk-harvest with Use.
strings.cfg_input__keyboardharvestmodifierkey_he: Hold this keyboard shortcut while using a ripe resource to harvest nearby resources within Harvest Radius.
strings.cfg_planting__preventpartialplanting_hel: On: refuse the entire grid if any cell cannot be planted. Off: plant the cells allowed by Prevent Invalid Planting. Placement permissions still apply to every cell.
strings.cfg_planting__preventinvalidplanting_hel: On: skip extra grid cells that fail growth or placement checks. Off: allow extra cells with biological or target failures; the root cell must still be valid and permission failures are never bypassed.
strings.cfg_planting__usestamina_help: On: planting with the cultivator uses the native stamina cost. Off: cultivator placement costs no stamina.
strings.cfg_planting__usedurability_help: On: cultivator placement uses its native durability cost. Off: planting does not reduce cultivator durability.
strings.cfg_general__enabled_help: On: enable Wildroot gardening when session permissions allow it. Off: cancel pending gardening work and release Wildroot changes. In multiplayer, the server owns this switch; installed source-mod step-aside still applies.
strings.cfg_grid__snappingenabled_help: On: align the planting grid with nearby plants or pickable resources. Off: place the grid at the unsnapped ghost position.
strings.cfg_grid__rows_help: Number of rows in the planting grid, from 1 to 10. With grid planting off, the layout is 1 by 1; Farming row perks can still affect eligible single-crop planting.
strings.cfg_grid__columns_help: Number of columns in the planting grid, from 1 to 10. The concurrent placement limit also caps the number of cells.
strings.cfg_planting__randomizerotation_help: On: choose a random heading in 22.5-degree steps for each placement. Off: keep the placement ghost heading. This is independent of position and tilt scatter.
strings.cfg_planting__enablescatter_help: On: apply configured position and tilt scatter to new placements. Off: keep grid positions without scatter. Randomize Rotation is a separate switch.
strings.cfg_planting__positionscatterradius_help: Maximum position offset in meters along each horizontal axis when scatter is enabled. Zero keeps the planned grid positions.
strings.cfg_planting__rotationscatterangle_help: Maximum pitch and roll offset in degrees when scatter is enabled. Zero adds no tilt; the heading is controlled separately.
strings.cfg_grid__globallyaligngriddirections_he: On: use the world-forward direction, rotated by the ghost heading, for unsnapped rows. Off: start with the player-to-ghost direction before applying that heading.
strings.cfg_grid__minimizegridspacing_help: On: crop spacing uses 1.1 times the grow radius plus the largest relevant capsule radius. Off: use twice the grow radius. Extra Crop Spacing is added in either mode; sapling spacing is separate.
strings.cfg_grid__gridsnappingstyle_help: Choose Intelligent snapping to orient grid axes around nearby valid space, or Legacy snapping to keep the selected snap axes.
strings.cfg_grid__forcealtplacement_help: On: always use alternate placement when choosing snap candidates and single-crop row perks. Off: use the native alternate-placement input.
strings.cfg_grid__prefercardinalsnapping_help: On: prefer forward, back, left or right snap positions when any valid cardinal candidate exists. Off: keep valid diagonal candidates too.
strings.cfg_grid__extracropspacing_help: Additional grid spacing in meters for crops, added to their calculated spacing. Saplings use Extra Sapling Spacing instead.
strings.cfg_grid__extrasaplingspacing_help: Additional grid spacing in meters for saplings, added to 2.2 times their grow radius.
strings.cfg_harvest__enabled_help: On: using a ripe resource with the harvest modifier starts a nearby bulk harvest. Off: disable bulk harvest; separate Farming auto-replant perks are not this switch.
strings.cfg_harvest__harveststyle_help: LikeResources harvests nearby ready resources that yield the same item as the target. AllResources includes other ready resources in range. Ward and loaded-area checks still apply.
strings.cfg_harvest__radius_help: Bulk-harvest radius in meters around the resource you use. Only ready resources with placement-area and ward access are selected.
strings.cfg_harvest__replant_help: On: after confirmed harvest, try to plant a replacement crop at the original position and pay its materials. Off: bulk harvest does not request this replant; eligible Farming auto-replant perks remain separate.
strings.cfg_performance__maxconcurrentplacements: Maximum cells and queued or in-flight placements Wildroot accepts at once. The value is at least 1 in use; larger values permit more work, while grid dimensions remain capped at 10 by 10.
strings.cfg_performance__ghostupdatebatchsize_he: Maximum extra preview ghosts updated per frame, with at least 1 in use. Larger values refresh a large preview sooner but do more work each frame.
strings.cfg_performance__bulkplantingbatchsize_h: Maximum queued placement jobs processed per update, clamped to 1 through 10000 in use. Larger values complete batches sooner but can increase work per frame.
strings.cfg_spacing_pickables__preventoverlappin: On: reject overlapping pickable-resource preview cells. Off: remove this extra overlap check. Terrain and placement permissions still apply.
strings.cfg_spacing_pickables__defaultgridspacin: Fallback grid spacing in meters for pickable resources without a per-prefab spacing or a native harvest radius.
strings.cfg_spacing_pickables__blueberrybush_gri: Grid spacing in meters between placements of prefab BlueberryBush. This changes placement spacing; it does not change the item's yield or respawn timer.
strings.cfg_spacing_pickables__cloudberrybush_gr: Grid spacing in meters between placements of prefab CloudberryBush. This changes placement spacing; it does not change the item's yield or respawn timer.

strings.cfg_spacing_pickables__pickable_stone_gr: Grid spacing in meters between placements of prefab Pickable_Stone. This changes placement spacing; it does not change the item's yield or respawn timer.
strings.cfg_spacing_pickables__pickable_thistle_: Grid spacing in meters between placements of prefab Pickable_Thistle. This changes placement spacing; it does not change the item's yield or respawn timer.

strings.cfg_spacing_pickables__raspberrybush_gri: Grid spacing in meters between placements of prefab RaspberryBush. This changes placement spacing; it does not change the item's yield or respawn timer.
strings.cfg_ui__showcost_help: On: add the grid count or full batch material cost to native requirement text when more than one cell is planned. Off: keep the native requirement display.
strings.cfg_preview__costdisplaystyle_help: TotalCount adds the number of planned cells; FullCost shows each requirement amount multiplied by that cell count. Requires Show Cost and a grid larger than one cell.
strings.cfg_preview__costdisplaylocation_help: Place the extra grid-count or material-cost text to the left or right of the native requirement text.
strings.cfg_preview__showhudkeyhints_help: On: show grid modifier and resize keys beside the grid size in the build hints. Off: retain the grid size without those key boxes.
strings.cfg_preview__showhoverkeyhints_help: On: add one hint line to ripe-resource hover text with the bulk-harvest modifier and Use key, plus the replacement crop while Harvest Replant is enabled. Off: omit that line.
strings.cfg_preview__showhoverreplanthint_help: On: include the configured replacement crop in the harvest hint line while Harvest Replant is enabled. Off: leave the crop out. Preview: ShowHoverKeyHints shows or hides the whole line. Actual planting still checks and charges materials.
strings.cfg_preview__showghostsduringplacement_h: On: keep unplaced preview silhouettes visible while a batch is being placed. Off: hide those silhouettes during placement.
strings.cfg_preview__showgriddirections_help: On: draw row and column guide lines for the planting grid. Off: hide the direction-line objects, including the snap line.
strings.cfg_preview__showsnapdirection_help: On: show the guide line from the snapped grid toward its snap source. Off: hide that line. Show Grid Directions must also be enabled.
strings.cfg_preview__highlightrootghost_help: On: tint the healthy root ghost when the grid contains more than one cell. Off: keep its normal ghost appearance.
strings.cfg_preview__rootghosthighlightcolor_hel: Color used for the healthy root ghost highlight. Requires Highlight Root Ghost and more than one grid cell.
strings.cfg_preview__rowstartcolor_help: Color at the start of the row-direction guide line. Requires Show Grid Directions.
strings.cfg_preview__rowendcolor_help: Color at the end of the row-direction guide line. Requires Show Grid Directions.
strings.cfg_preview__columnstartcolor_help: Color at the start of the column-direction guide line. Requires Show Grid Directions.
strings.cfg_preview__columnendcolor_help: Color at the end of the column-direction guide line. Requires Show Grid Directions.
strings.cfg_preview__snapstartcolor_help: Color at the start of the snap-direction guide line. Requires Show Grid Directions and Show Snap Direction.
strings.cfg_preview__snapendcolor_help: Color at the end of the snap-direction guide line. Requires Show Grid Directions and Show Snap Direction.

strings.cfg_growth_crops__enablecropoverrides_he: On: apply Wildroot crop cost, yield, scale, growth-time and growing-condition overrides. Off: keep the captured native crop values. Other gardening features remain controlled separately.
strings.cfg_growth_crops__overridemoddedcrops_he: On: apply the crop growth and condition overrides to third-party crops too. Off: leave those crops unchanged. Requires Enable Crop Overrides.
strings.cfg_growth_crops__cropminscale_help: Minimum crop scale multiplier when crop overrides are enabled. Must be positive; the effective maximum is raised to at least this value.
strings.cfg_growth_crops__cropmaxscale_help: Maximum crop scale multiplier when crop overrides are enabled. Effective maximum cannot be lower than Crop Min Scale.
strings.cfg_growth_crops__cropgrowtimemin_help: Minimum crop growth time in seconds when crop overrides are enabled. Invalid or negative values keep the captured baseline.
strings.cfg_growth_crops__cropgrowtimemax_help: Maximum crop growth time in seconds when crop overrides are enabled. Effective maximum is raised to at least Crop Grow Time Min.
strings.cfg_growth_crops__cropgrowradius_help: Crop growth-clearance radius in meters when crop overrides are enabled. Grid spacing is calculated from this radius too.
strings.cfg_growth_crops__cropsrequirecultivatio: On: crops require cultivated ground. Off: remove that requirement. Requires Enable Crop Overrides; other placement restrictions still apply.
strings.cfg_growth_crops__cropsrequiresunlight_h: On: crops need open sky. Off: allow growth under a roof. Requires Enable Crop Overrides.
strings.cfg_growth_crops__cropsrequiregrowthspac: On: crops need clear space within their growth radius. Off: remove that growth-space check. Requires Enable Crop Overrides.
strings.cfg_growth_crops__enemiestargetcrops_hel: On: enemies may target the configured crops. Off: remove their normal target flag. Requires Enable Crop Overrides.

strings.cfg_restrictions__requirecultivation_hel: On: added pickable resources require cultivated ground. Off: they can be placed on ordinary ground. Crop cultivation has its own override setting.
strings.cfg_restrictions__placeanywhere_help: On: eligible saplings, bushes and decorative plants can leave the ground and ignore roof and growth-space checks. Off: keep those restrictions. Crops, mushrooms, flowers and fixed-ground debris do not gain this behavior; permissions still apply.
strings.cfg_restrictions__enforcebiomes_help: On: added cloned saplings and vines use their configured growth biome mask. Off: permit all biomes for those plants. Native plants use Enforce Biomes Vanilla.
strings.cfg_restrictions__enforcebiomesvanilla_h: On: native crops and saplings retain their growth biome restrictions. Off: use all biomes. Other growth and shielding checks remain separate.
strings.cfg_restrictions__ashlandscrops_help: On: carrots, onions, turnips, oats, poteitr and kale, and their seed crops, grow in the Ashlands as they do in the game and PlantEverything 1.21.4. There they still need a shield unless the planter's Farming level reaches HeatToleranceLevel. Off: these crops do not grow in the Ashlands. Barley, flax, magecap, Jotun puffs and the Ashlands' own plants are not affected. Applies while EnforceBiomesVanilla is on.
strings.cfg_restrictions__plantsrequireshielding: On: plants retain their normal heat and cold tolerances and may need a shield in harsh biomes. Off: configured plants tolerate those environmental conditions.
strings.cfg_restrictions__canremoveflora_help: On: added decorative flora can be removed. Off: keep that decorative flora non-removable. Other piece kinds follow their existing rules.
strings.cfg_restrictions__recoverresources_help: On: recover placement materials when removing added berry bushes, mushrooms or flowers. Off: removing them does not refund those materials.
strings.cfg_restrictions__resourcesspawnempty_he: On: added berries, mushrooms, flowers and debris start picked and wait for their respawn timer. Off: they start ready to pick. A zero respawn time does not replenish them.
strings.cfg_restrictions__enemiestargetpieces_he: On: enemies may target added non-crop pieces. Off: remove their normal target flags. Crop overrides have a separate Enemies Target Crops switch.

strings.cfg_catalog__showpickablespawners_help: On: retain a visible picked spawner for configured mushrooms, thistle, dandelion and fiddlehead. Off: hide their picked spawner representation.
strings.cfg_catalog__enablemiscflora_help: On: make decorative flora entries available in the cultivator catalog. Off: disable those entries without changing their identities.
strings.cfg_catalog__enabledebris_help: On: include branch, stone and flint resource entries in the cultivator catalog. Off: disable those debris entries.
strings.cfg_catalog__enableextraresources_help: On: load extra-resource definitions from the authority file and synchronize them to clients. Off: omit those extra definitions; ordinary catalog entries are unchanged.
strings.cfg_catalog__snappablevines_help: On: add Wildroot snap points to the decorative vines piece. Off: remove only those added snap points; native snap points remain intact.
strings.cfg_catalog__disabledresourcenames_help: Comma-separated prefab names to disable in the cultivator catalog. Names are trimmed and case-sensitive; an empty list disables no entries. Applies to extra resources too.

strings.cfg_growth_saplings__overridemoddedsapli: On: apply the Modded Sapling growth time, scale and radius to third-party saplings. Off: keep their native growth settings.
strings.cfg_growth_saplings__moddedsaplingminsca: Minimum grown scale multiplier for third-party saplings. Must be positive; the effective maximum is raised to at least this value. Requires Override Modded Saplings.
strings.cfg_growth_saplings__moddedsaplingmaxsca: Maximum grown scale multiplier for third-party saplings. Effective maximum cannot be below its minimum scale. Requires Override Modded Saplings.
strings.cfg_growth_saplings__moddedsaplinggrowth: Growth time in seconds for third-party saplings. The effective minimum is 10 seconds. Requires Override Modded Saplings.
strings.cfg_growth_saplings__moddedsaplinggrowra: Growth-clearance radius in meters for third-party saplings. This also contributes to grid spacing. Requires Override Modded Saplings.

strings.cfg_drops__enableseedoverrides_help: On: replace tree drop-roll counts and chances and the stack range for seeds, cones, acorns and sap. Off: restore the captured native drop tables.
strings.cfg_drops__seeddropmin_help: Minimum stack amount for seeds, cones, acorns and sap in tree destruction drops. Requires Enable Seed Overrides; negative values become 0.
strings.cfg_drops__seeddropmax_help: Maximum stack amount for those planting materials in tree destruction drops. Requires Enable Seed Overrides; effective maximum is at least Seed Drop Min.
strings.cfg_drops__treedropmin_help: Minimum number of tree drop rolls when Enable Seed Overrides is on. Negative values become 0; this is not the number of logs or wood in each stack.
strings.cfg_drops__treedropmax_help: Maximum number of tree drop rolls when Enable Seed Overrides is on. Effective maximum is at least Tree Drop Min.
strings.cfg_drops__dropchance_help: Chance of a successful tree drop roll, from 0 to 1, when Enable Seed Overrides is on. 0.5 means 50%; values outside the range are clamped.
strings.cfg_drops__oneofeach_help: On: the overridden tree drop table selects each item type at most once. Off: repeated selections are allowed. Requires Enable Seed Overrides.
strings.cfg_hover__enablepickabletimers_help: On: append remaining respawn time to hover text for picked, replenishing resources. Off: omit that timer. Resources with no respawn time have no countdown.
strings.cfg_hover__enableplanttimers_help: On: append remaining growth time to a plant's hover text. Off: omit that timer.
strings.cfg_hover__growthaspercentage_help: On: show completed growth or respawn progress as a whole percentage. Off: show remaining time in hours, minutes and seconds. Requires the matching hover timer.
strings.cfg_growth_vines__enablevineoverrides_he: On: apply vine attachment, growth time, growth radius and berry yield/respawn overrides. Off: keep the captured vine values.
strings.cfg_growth_vines__vineattachdistance_hel: Maximum native vine attachment distance in meters when vine overrides are enabled.
strings.cfg_growth_vines__vinegrowradius_help: Growth-clearance radius in meters for vines when vine overrides are enabled.
strings.cfg_growth_vines__vinegrowthtime_help: Time in seconds for a planted vine to grow when vine overrides are enabled.
strings.cfg_growth_vines__vineberryrespawntime_h: Minutes before berries on a grown vine replenish when vine overrides are enabled. Zero gives no replenishment.
strings.cfg_growth_vines__vineberryreturn_help: Number of berry items harvested from a grown vine when vine overrides are enabled.
strings.cfg_presentation__language_help: Language of Wildroot's own text. Auto follows the game's language; a named language overrides it for Wildroot only. Your own display choice.
strings.cfg_gardening__unrestricted_help: Cheat: plant anywhere and let plants grow without space, sunlight, biome or temperature limits. Off by default; in multiplayer the server's value applies and its cheat policy decides who may place this way.
strings.cfg_presentation__exportenglishreference: Set to true to write Wildroot's English text to a reference file for translators. Wildroot writes it once and sets this back to false.
strings.cfg_grid__enabled_help: Plant in a grid of Rows by Columns cells with each cultivator use. Off: plant one at a time. Grid: ToggleKey switches this in game.
strings.cfg_grid__togglekey_help: Key that turns grid planting (Grid: Enabled) on or off while you play. Unbound by default.
strings.cfg_farm__togglekey_help: No longer used: farming mode was removed and this key does nothing. Grid planting and bulk harvesting still in progress stop when you open the pause menu or another window.
strings.cfg_harvest__replanttarget_help: What replanting after a bulk harvest plants. Original: the same crop that was picked. Selected: the crop currently selected on your cultivator; any other selection keeps the original crop.
strings.cfg_catalog__extraresourcesshared_help: Managed by Wildroot: the server's extra-resource definitions sent to clients. Edit extra-resources.cfg instead.
strings.cfg_catalog__serverfingerprint_help: Managed by Wildroot: the server's catalog fingerprint; clients compare their own catalog against it.
strings.cfg_import__importreferencesettings_help: Set to true to import PlantEasily and PlantEverything settings once; Wildroot backs up this file first, writes a report to Wildroot/import-report.txt and sets this back to false.
strings.cfg_import__conflictchoices_help: Conflict choices for the import, as Target=SourceSetting pairs separated by semicolons.
strings.cfg_import__bindingoverrides_help: Replacement shortcuts for import collisions, as Target=Key pairs separated by semicolons.
strings.cfg_farming__enabled_help: Farming skill perks and experience scaling. Off leaves the game's own Farming skill unchanged.
strings.cfg_farming__growthspeedat100_help: Percent faster growth at level 100 for everything a player plants, from the planter's level.
strings.cfg_farming__growspacereductionat100_hel: Percent less room a planted crop needs around it at level 100, from the planter's level.
strings.cfg_farming__bonusyieldchanceat100_help: Bonus crop chance in percent at level 100 when picking, in place of the game's 25%.
strings.cfg_farming__seedreturnchanceat100_help: Chance in percent at level 100 that picking a crop also gives back its seed.
strings.cfg_farming__raingrowthbonus_help: Percent faster growth while it rains, for everything a player planted.
strings.cfg_farming__rowofthreelevel_help: From this level, planting one crop at a time (a 1 x 1 grid) plants a row of three. 101 turns it off.
strings.cfg_farming__rowoffivelevel_help: From this level, a row of five. 101 turns it off.
strings.cfg_farming__autoreplantlevel_help: From this level, picking a crop plants it again in the same spot, paid from your inventory. 101 turns it off.
strings.cfg_farming__heattolerancelevel_help: From this planter level, crops grow in the Ashlands without a shield. 101 turns it off.
strings.cfg_farming__coldtolerancelevel_help: From this planter level, crops that grow in the Meadows also grow in the Mountain and Deep North. 101 turns it off.
strings.cfg_farming__experiencemultiplier_help: Multiplies Farming experience from planting and picking.
strings.cfg_farming__tierscaling_help: Richer crops teach more: experience is multiplied by the crop's value over TierReferenceValue, never below 1.
strings.cfg_farming__tierreferencevalue_help: The crop value (health + stamina + eitr, or what it is milled or cooked into) that earns the game's own experience.
strings.cfg_farming__tiermaximummultiplier_help: The most TierScaling multiplies experience by.
strings.cfg_farming__discoverymultiplier_help: Experience multiplier the first time a character picks each kind of crop.
strings.cfg_farming__rowplanting_help: Your own switch for the row-of-three and row-of-five perks.
strings.cfg_farming__autoreplant_help: Your own switch for the auto-replant perk.
strings.cfg_seedcrafting__enabled_help: Workbench recipes that turn one carrot, turnip, onion, kale or poteitr into two of its seeds.
strings.cfg_grid__sizepreset_help: Your grid size. Vanilla: 1 by 1; MeadWorksDefault: 2 by 2; Relaxed: 4 by 4. Custom keeps your numbers. Choosing a preset writes Rows and Columns immediately; editing either number selects Custom. Saved numbers are never replaced on load.
strings.cfg_grid__spacingpreset_help: Your extra spacing between plants. Vanilla and MeadWorksDefault: no extra spacing; Relaxed: 0.5 meters for crops and 1 meter for saplings. Custom keeps your numbers. Choosing a preset applies immediately; editing either extra spacing selects Custom. Saved numbers are never replaced on load.
strings.cfg_planting__effortpreset_help: Host-owned cultivator effort. Vanilla and MeadWorksDefault: native stamina and durability costs, partial planting allowed, invalid extra cells skipped. Relaxed: no stamina or durability cost, with the same placement checks. Custom keeps your choices. Changes apply immediately; editing a member selects Custom. Saved choices are never replaced on load.
strings.cfg_farming__progressionpreset_help: Host-owned Farming progression. Vanilla turns off Wildroot Farming perks and extra experience scaling. MeadWorksDefault restores Wildroot growth, yield, seed, rain, perk-level and experience defaults. Relaxed gives faster growth, more yields and seeds, earlier perks and 1.5 times experience. Custom keeps your values. Changes apply immediately; editing a member selects Custom. Saved values are never replaced on load. Your RowPlanting and AutoReplant switches are kept.
strings.cfg_growth_crops__overridepreset_help: Host-owned crop overrides. Vanilla and MeadWorksDefault disable overrides and set scale to 0.9-1.1, growth to 4000-5000 seconds and clearance to 0.5 meters. Relaxed enables overrides with 2000-2500 seconds, the same scale and clearance. Custom keeps your values. Changes apply immediately; editing a member selects Custom. Saved values are never replaced on load. Growing-condition switches are kept.
